name: Documentation alignment with the agreed Cook architecture
description: Documentation-only cleanup for issue #1. Source: tasks/prd-documentation-alignment.md. Document the agreed intended architecture and reconcile stale definitions case by case; keep current-implementation claims accurate. No mandatory quality gates. Do not implement product changes, finalize model APIs, enforce acyclic documentation links, or update GitHub issues. Stories split large PRD groups into focused page groups and run sequentially because they edit shared indexes and cross-references. Do not modify the unrelated tasks/prd.json.

userStories.title: Establish the architecture's responsibilities
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want one authoritative explanation of Cook's responsibilities so that I do not build features from an obsolete product definition. Read tasks/prd-documentation-alignment.md, including its architecture requirements, non-goals, and open questions. This task changes documentation only; do not implement product behavior or settle the deferred ingredient/recipe model and hooks. No mandatory quality gates or check commands are requested. Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and tasks/prd.json. Source PRD story: US-001.
acceptanceCriteria: Rewrite the scope, responsibilities, and boundaries in `docs/architecture.md` around FR-1 through FR-6.
Remove the Go-only, no-code, fixed-SDLC-core, and three-current-product-parts claims from the intended architecture.
Preserve ingredients as program data models and cookbook distribution as separate from the engine.
Keep model APIs and hooks explicitly outside the decisions made by this document, without adopting exploratory syntax.
Remove document lifecycle/status machinery; architecture states the design rather than an implementation progress table.

userStories.title: Specify ordered file operations
userStories.description: As a recipe author, I want the architecture to define exactly what Cook applies and discards so that overlap and manual edits have predictable results. Read tasks/prd-documentation-alignment.md, including its architecture requirements, non-goals, and open questions. This task changes documentation only; do not implement product behavior or settle the deferred ingredient/recipe model and hooks. No mandatory quality gates or check commands are requested. Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and tasks/prd.json. Source PRD story: US-002.
acceptanceCriteria: Document FR-7 through FR-16 in the architecture.
Include an example where recipe A sets a key and recipe B overrides it; the final preview shows B's result.
Include an example where applying B leaves A's unrelated output intact.
Contrast discard and revert using a key changed from `old` to `new`, then manually to `custom`: discard proposes deletion; reverting the original run proposes `custom` to `old`.
Explain markers as text boundaries and remove ownership/adoption/drift enforcement from the target operation contract.
State that apply/discard always evaluate the supplied recipes against current content, even after an earlier identical invocation; history does not mark recipes as already applied.
